description: Navigate and fight sentries through a shared visual beat.
name: Clockbeat Catacomb V2 · Difficulty 2 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Defeat every sentry and enter the stair alive. Wind the clock, then use arrows or WASD (Space waits) once during each gold beat window. Off-beat presses do nothing; sentries still act at each beat boundary. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
